painpoints.text: Run-container mise config is untrusted, so the first `sd ready` call failed with 'Config files in /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml are not trusted' and the planner burned a tool call on `mise trust` before any tracker read worked (this run, 01M1S6VRWQMD56M1X8HWAXDSNN). Already tracked as seed fabro-66db 'sandbox: pre-trust the repo mise config in run containers' — the pain recurred here, which strengthens its case.

observations: Tracker holds 126 ready seeds; `sd ready --limit 200` put fabro-78ac first among High — picked it after verifying its basis is live (create-then-start `?` at lib/components/fabro-tool/src/create.rs:453-464) rather than stale.

Resolved a spec ambiguity in the brief: the seed's 'created <id>, start blocked: ...' example reads like summary text but the real fix belongs in the structured CreatedRunResult (additive JsonSchema field preferred); documented that post-failure run state is unknown, so the error must be reported verbatim, not mapped to 'pending'.

Multi-line perl -0pi field insertion into four MockCreateBackend constructors in `lib/components/fabro-tool/src/create.rs` mangled two lines (captured group swallowed `Mutex::new(Vec::new())`); caught immediately by inspecting rg output and fixed with a second targeted pass, then verified by compiling tests. Risk class: regex transforms over constructor literals silently drop adjacent tokens — always re-grep the transformed lines before building.

painpoints.text: Tester gate RED was formatting-only (run 01M1S6VRWQMD56M1X8HWAXDSNN, lib/components/fabro-tool/src/create.rs:942): the implementer stage's instruction to skip fmt to avoid redundant gate runs let whitespace drift reach the deterministic gate. Suggestion: allow/require implementer to run `cargo +nightly-2026-04-14 fmt -p <touched-crate>` as part of its ONE focused check — it is sub-second with a warm toolchain and would have saved a full tester cycle.

observations: The gate failure was purely cosmetic (struct-literal alignment in test fixtures); the partial-success implementation and its tests were already correct, confirmed by 67/67 passing nextest run for fabro-tool.

Tester gate flagged only two style lints (map_unwrap_or, format_push_string) in create.rs — the implementer pass shipped without any clippy run because the role contract forbids gating; a cheap `cargo clippy -p <touched crate>` compile-check equivalent would catch these pre-gate at near-zero cost (run 01M1S6VRWQMD56M1X8HWAXDSNN, two tester cycles burned).
